title: I made a pixel fantasy ARPG where death is permanent. First person to beat the final boss gets their name pinned here.
author: Jonesiller5383
selftext:
I just finished my game Aestra: The Last Wish is a real-time pixel action RPG. I made it with AI in approx 1 months of working on it (mostly weekends).

You start at lvl 1 and need to grind & quest your way to lvl 60, through various zones/biomes. Choose between 3 talent trees per class. Gear up, professions and whatever you do, don't die. As death is permanent and you need to start over.

Every zone has a normal dungeon and a heroic one (for after you completed the last boss)

In the final zone you have the Aestra tower you need to ascend (you get access through a MSQ-style quest line. So make sure to do all the quests.

* **Permadeath.** When you die, your hero is gone for good. Only the very rare Embers of Rebirth can bring you back, and you might find one or two in a whole run.

**The challenge:** **nobody has beaten Aestra at the top of the tower yet.**

  
The game takes multiple playthroughs and every class has 3 different talents/builds and various different playstyles. It's quite addictive once you get into it :) I've had 75 people play it today and the max lvl so far is 42. Most people need 4 playthroughs to get to level 25

Comments are the leaderboard. Post your hero's name, class, highest level and what killed you (the title screen's Hall of the Fallen shows it). The first person to post a screenshot of Aestra defeated gets their name pinned at the top of this post.

Play free in your browser: [Play Aestra](https://tesana.com/game/aestra-the-last-wish)

comments.author: This-Tone-2280
comments.body:
My notes from an afternoon of playing today. I did enjoy it. Killing the boss twice was satisfying

For a game that is hardcore its too easy to level with gathering hobbies as they scale when you level especially problematic in fishing since things should be dangerous   
In combat when not in combat but near someone who is in combat so it makes me in combat  
More clear indication on what i am selecting for quest rewards  
Not being able to use potions at full hp  
An indicator that my class cant use something before i buy it  
Maybe make fishing like ten uses then it has a cooldown or something i can just sit there all day with no danger and the fish doesnt seem to move also i fished about 113 times or so and got 3 embers of rebirth  
Would like stat tooltips to see what they do or how each stat might help me

tree dense areas are annoying

cheers mate. i had fun

comments.author: Quirky-Split7157
comments.body: Had fun, but there is some serious imbalance in the game. Going from a starting area where mobs did nothing to the level 10 area (was almost level 10) where I got 1shot by a wolf that looked exactly like the ones I had just beaten. (+200 hp)

replies.author: Jonesiller5383
replies.body: Haha game is brutal. You gotta be very careful with checking the mobs levels and how you approach them. Maybe I have tuned the game a bit too hard. But I want it to feel vicious and rewarding. Did you play some more?

replies.author: iceiee
replies.body: i think the point of his comment was that enemies should look different if they are stronger. even a recolor. something so the player knows to take a double look

replies.author: Jonesiller5383
replies.body: Ahh got it, true. Will work on that

replies.author: iceiee
replies.body: also good job btw you have really good art if ai generated. thats what im struggling most with my game.

replies.author: Jonesiller5383
replies.body: I have now updated so all enemies look completely unique at all levels :) thanks for the feedback

replies.author: Quirky-Split7157
replies.body:
iceiee got it right.

There is no issue with mobs being hard. The issue is that it is impossible to know the powerlevel or what the impact is vs my items and stats. This is probably some of the areas that is hard for an AI to judge.

I actually stopped playing after this as I felt that if scaling was this much off at an early stage of the game, why would I want to waste hours for this to happen randomly again.

replies.author: Jonesiller5383
replies.body: The scaling is super tight I've played through myself on every character, every spec :)
